_comment: Project-internal tool parameter schemas (NOT an ElevenLabs API import). API_CONTRACT.md v1.0, 2026-11-02.

tools.name: openInfo
tools.description: Open a permitted demo info topic in the local app, and report the actual client result.

tools.name: openVideo
tools.description: Show the permitted local demo video; do not promise autoplay.

tools.name: openLogbook
tools.description: Open the local in-memory demo logbook without modifying it.

tools.name: proposeLogEntry
tools.description: Propose a fictitious exercise entry for explicit confirmation; do not save it.

tools.name: confirmLogEntry
tools.description: Attempt confirmation/cancellation of pending demo entry. Browser validates separate final user confirmation or requires touch.

tools.name: setProactivity
tools.description: Enable or disable optional exercise follow-up only by user request; default disabled.
